abstract.para: Sampling data captured in Oceanic Exploration Research In 2017 (Year 4 of the exploration contract), a multidisciplinary offshore campaign named “GSRNOD17” was conducted by Global Sea Mineral Resources NV (GSR), subsidiary company of the DEME‐Group, in its offshore claim area (Clarion‐Clipperton Zone – CCZ), pursuant to the exploration contract concluded with the International Seabed Authority (ISA). The expedition took place on board of the MV Topaz Captain, from mid‐May to early July 2018 (42 days offshore), involving 52 persons on board (crew, engineers, scientists and experts) but also a significant onshore support.
